instructions:
1. Stand side-on to a wall about 60 cm away, feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball with both hands.
2. Rotate your torso away from the wall, bringing the ball across your body.
3. Forcefully rotate back toward the wall and slam the ball into it at hip-to-chest height.
4. Catch or pick up the rebound and reset to the start.
5. Complete the reps, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive the rotation from your hips and core, not just your arms.
2. Keep your spine tall and avoid rounding your back.
3. Brace your abs throughout to protect the lower back.
4. Exhale sharply as you slam the ball.
name: Med ball side wall slams_Female

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball at chest height.
2. Lower into a squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
3. Drive up through your heels to stand.
4. As you rise, press the ball overhead until your arms are extended.
5. Lower the ball back to your chest.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core braced through the squat.
2. Press the ball overhead in one fluid motion with the leg drive.
3. Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
4. Breathe out as you stand and press.
name: Med ball front squat raise

instructions:
1. Kneel in a half-kneeling position with one knee up and one knee down.
2. Hold a medicine ball with both hands beside the hip of the down knee.
3. Rotate your torso and lift the ball diagonally across your body toward the side of the raised knee.
4. Control the ball back down to the starting hip.
5. Complete the reps, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive the movement from your core, keeping your arms fairly straight.
2. Keep your hips and shoulders square and stable in the kneeling position.
3. Exhale as you chop upward.
4. Move with control rather than swinging.
name: Med ball half kneeling wood choppers

instructions:
1. Stand with feet together, holding a medicine ball at chest height.
2. Jump your feet out wide while pressing the ball overhead.
3. Jump your feet back together while lowering the ball to your chest.
4. Keep a steady, rhythmic pace.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Land softly through the balls of your feet to absorb impact.
2. Keep your core braced as you press overhead.
3. Coordinate the arm press with the leg movement.
4. Maintain a controlled rhythm rather than rushing.
name: Med ball jumping jacks

instructions:
1. Stand close to a large tyre lying flat, feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Squat down and grip the bottom edge of the tyre with both hands.
3. Drive through your legs and hips to lift the tyre to a standing position.
4. As it rises, drop one knee under and push the tyre forward to flip it over.
5. Step forward, reset your grip, and continue.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lift with your legs and hips, keeping your back flat.
2. Keep your chest against the tyre as you drive up.
3. Explode through the hips to convert the lift into the flip.
4. Brace your core hard before each lift.
name: Tyre Flip
